description.value: Attio is a CRM platform positioned for 'agentic revenue.' It says it 'builds pipeline, advances deals, and grows accounts around the clock.'
Attio is a London-based, AI-native CRM company aiming to offer a flexible, data-driven alternative to traditional CRM systems.

product_description.value: Context (Universal Context, Data Model, Enrichment, Call Intelligence, Reporting & Forecasts); Orchestration (Ask Attio, Workflows, Custom Agents, Web Agent, Sequences); an app marketplace, MCP support, and a developer platform with an SDK and API.
A customizable CRM with reporting and analytics, pipeline and deal management, and an App SDK for building custom apps.

business_model_description.value: Free start with paid plans (a 'Pro plan' is mentioned in a demo), a startup program, and sales-led contact.
Subscription software business with a freemium model: a Free plan for small teams plus Plus, Pro, and Enterprise tiers. Software Advice lists pricing from $29-$69/month.

customer_description.value: Trusted by 30,000+ customers. Featured customer stories include Granola, Modal, Railway, and TaskRabbit.

Targets high-growth technology companies. One profile reports over 5,000 paying customers, including Lovable, Modal, Replicate, and Public. Bloomberg describes customers as startups, scale-ups, SaaS companies, SMBs, and investors in Europe, the United States, and the United Kingdom.

employees.value: 166 as of March 2026 (Revelio Labs); 40 and 62 (GetLatka); 30 total (Built In); 140 (a second Built In listing)
